entry.title: dotnet/runtime - Issues & Pull Requests - 2025-08-23
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • [NativeAOT] Finalizers should not run for objects with unsuccessful class init (.cctor) #119038
  • [API Proposal]: ISorted<T> for sorted collections #119036

Closed

  • XHarness General Failure in tVOS.Device.Aot.Test #119008
  • CS8911 Using a function pointer type in this context is not supported #119035
  • Console.WriteLine hangs in ASP.NET Core NativeAOT when published as Library and invoked via P/Invoke #118773
  • [NativeAOT] possible deadlock due to InitializeRuntime reentrancy if ModuleInitializer launches threads. #107699
    Future
  • Increase file descriptor limit in NativeAOT app process #82719
    Future
  • [API Proposal]: `RuntimeHelpers.Unbox` for fast unchecked unboxing #118989

PullRequests

Created

  • [TEST ONLY] Testing GC stress fixes with faster GC stress #119037
    NO-MERGE, NO-REVIEW, area-VM-coreclr
  • Use `UnmanagedCallersOnly` in `AssemblyDependencyResolver`. #119034
    area-Host, community-contribution
  • Fix character/byte confusion in `System.Diagnostics.EventLog` #119033
    area-System.Diagnostics.EventLog, community-contribution
  • Fixes trying to create a module using a trash as the address of the module #119031
    needs-area-label
  • Fix DateTimeOffset deserialization in IXmlSerializable context #119030
  • Make wasm corerun build regular #119029
    arch-wasm, area-Infrastructure-coreclr, 11.0.0
  • Fix GCStress regression #119028
    area-VM-coreclr
  • [release/8.0] Bump usages of MicroBuild task to v4 #119027
    8.0.x

Merged

  • Adjust so that we only require FEAT_LSE for osx-arm64 and maccatalyst, not for iOS or tvOS #119032
    needs-area-label
  • Fix deadlock when creating threads from ModuleInitializer in a shared library #118928
    area-NativeAOT-coreclr
  • Increase file descriptor limit in native AOT executables #118995
    area-PAL-coreclr
  • [NativeAOT] Remove a few indirections and some dead code #118970
    community-contribution, area-NativeAOT-coreclr

Updated

  • Replace Marshal.PtrToStringUni and Marshal.StringToCoTaskMemUni with Utf16StringMarshaller #118997
  • [mono][AOT] gsharedvt - stop validating generic constraints #119004
    NO-REVIEW, area-Codegen-AOT-mono, 10.0.0
  • [NativeAOT] Fix floating pointer register unwinding on Arm32 #118944
    area-NativeAOT-coreclr
  • Improve `ImmutableArrayExtensions.SequenceEqual` #118932
    area-System.Collections, community-contribution
  • [WASI] Align WASI compiler configuration with Unix #118929
    community-contribution, os-wasi, needs-area-label
  • Disable tests parallelization in flaky OleDB tests #119018
    area-System.Data.OleDB
  • Avoid `Marshal.PtrToStructure` in `NativeWrapper` #118996
    area-System.Diagnostics.EventLog, community-contribution
  • [release/10.0-rc1] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #118810
    linkable-framework, area-codeflow
  • Throttle finalization a bit when doing GC stress. #118879
    GCStress, area-VM-coreclr
  • Implement out-of-process SetThreadContext support for debugger detach #118849
    area-Diagnostics-coreclr, 10.0.0
  • Enhance consistency of StreamReader and StreamWriter #118958
    area-System.IO, community-contribution
  • [cDAC] Implement GetMethodTableSlot and GetMethodTableSlotEnum #118960
    area-Diagnostics-coreclr
  • [RISC-V] R2RDump: revamp probing quirks #118980
    area-crossgen2-coreclr, community-contribution, arch-riscv
  • [release/10.0] Implement UnhandledException hook for finalizer scenario in Mono. #118878
    NO-MERGE, Servicing-consider, area-VM-meta-mono, linkable-framework, 10.0.0
  • [TEST] No-op comment change #114048
    NO-REVIEW, test-enhancement, area-VM-coreclr
